name: listbox
need: Choose one or several options from a visible list: groups, descriptions, type-ahead, thousands of options

--ds-listbox-option-height.description: listbox option: the base height (size md, comfortable density) that size and density steps apply to; a least height, its text may need more

--ds-listbox-max-height.description: the listbox box's height before it scrolls (about six options); `none` shows every option

--ds-listbox-radius.description: the corners of the listbox box, times `--ds-shape`

ripple..ds-listbox__option: an option is chosen by a press, the state layer and the check are the feedback, as in the combobox
